raw.title: Senior BI Developer (m/f/d) - Microsoft Fabric & Power BI
raw.description:
Remote, CET/CEST or SAST-aligned time zones | Full-time | Start: as soon as possible

Build business-critical data products that turn trusted data into better decisions and action.

Using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and Azure, you will create lakehouses, semantic models, reports and AI-driven data products. These can include automated workflows, bots, copilots and agents.

You use AI-native delivery methods as a professional standard. This includes current LLMs, automation and agent platforms where they improve the product or solve a real client problem.

MultiBase delivers business-critical BI and analytics solutions for mid-sized companies across the DACH region. Since 1991, we have completed 1,500+ projects for 400+ clients. Our work covers manufacturing, automotive, financial services, pharma and other data-intensive sectors.

We are hiring a Senior BI Developer to expand capacity across established long-term client work. You bring technical depth, ownership and the ability to discuss your own technical topics directly with clients.

Tasks

The role

You build, test, document and maintain data products. This includes data models, lakehouses, data warehouses, pipelines, notebooks and Power BI reports.

You report to a Tech Lead and work closely with project leads, other developers and client teams. You clarify the technical detail and estimate the effort before delivery starts. You show what you built and explain your decisions clearly.

Project leadership, commercial ownership and people management remain with the project lead. Your mandate is senior technical delivery, direct technical client communication and reliable execution.

You work within MultiBase's DECIDE delivery framework: Discover, Engage, Clarify, Illustrate, Develop and Embed. You receive structured onboarding into the client context, delivery standards and framework.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain BI and data products in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and Azure.
  • Deliver lakehouse, warehouse, pipeline, notebook, SQL object and reporting components.
  • Develop Power BI semantic models, reports and DAX calculations.
  • Translate defined business needs into clear technical stories and delivery steps.
  • Discuss your own technical topics directly with client IT and business stakeholders.
  • Work in structured agile delivery. Estimate work, manage your stories and deliver against sprint commitments.
  • Use AI tools systematically to improve your development, analysis, documentation and quality assurance workflows.
  • Design and develop AI-driven data products that connect trusted client data, LLMs and defined business workflows.
  • Identify and prototype practical use cases for automations, bots, copilots and agents within client data environments.
  • Turn proven AI prototypes into secure, documented and maintainable data products.
  • Test, document and deploy production-ready data products.
  • Use version control and collaborative delivery practices, ideally Git and Azure DevOps.
  • Raise delivery risks, data issues and unclear requirements early with the Tech Lead and project lead.
  • Identify concrete improvement opportunities in client data landscapes.Contribute reusable documentation and practical knowledge to MultiBase's internal knowledge base.

Requirements

Who you are

You are technical first. You also communicate comfortably with a client's controller, data architect or business lead.

You ask clear questions before you build. You explain trade-offs directly. You take responsibility for your work and communicate early when an issue needs attention.

You look beyond dashboards and reports. You recognize when a trusted data product, automated workflow or AI-driven bot, copilot or agent is the right way to create insight or improve a client process.

You enjoy a role with real ownership, direct client exposure and a high standard of delivery.

Essential experience

  • At least four years of BI or data-platform development experience, including direct work with client or business stakeholders.
  • Strong Azure data-platform experience, including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory or Synapse.
  • Practical experience with lakehouse and data warehouse concepts, data pipelines and notebooks.
  • Professional Power BI capability, including semantic modeling, DAX and report development.
  • Strong SQL and dimensional data-modeling skills, including star-schema design and ETL/ELT patterns.
  • Experience delivering in agile teams using structured stories, estimates and sprint commitments.
  • Experience using Git and a collaborative development workflow. Azure DevOps is an advantage.
  • Experience testing, deploying and maintaining production data products.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.
  • Daily, thoughtful use of AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or equivalent. You verify outputs and remain accountable for quality.

Strong advantages

  • Hands-on experience designing, building or deploying AI-driven data products, bots, copilots or agents for real business use cases.
  • Experience with current LLMs and small language models, including practical decisions about model choice, cost, latency, privacy and quality.
  • Experience with LLM APIs, agent orchestration or automation platforms such as OpenClaw, Claude Code or Cowork, Hermes, n8n, Make or comparable tools.
  • Experience turning LLM, SLM or agent prototypes into secure and maintainable data products.
  • Databricks experience, especially for data engineering, lakehouse and notebook-based work.
  • Python or PySpark for data engineering, automation or notebook workflows.
  • German at B2 level or above for DACH client communication.
  • Experience delivering in a client-facing project environment.
  • A habit of actively sharing knowledge with teammates and contributing to the growth of company expertise.
  • An active interest in market and technology developments, which you bring back to the team rather than keep to yourself.

Benefits

The working environment

  • Remote-first across CET/CEST or SAST-aligned time zones.
  • Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 16:00 CET/CEST.
  • Occasional client visits are part of the role, normally several times per year and no more than once a quarter.
  • Developers based outside Germany attend working sessions at the MultiBase headquarters in Gilching at least twice a year.
  • Direct access to senior management, the Tech Lead and experienced project leads.
  • Access to current AI and development tools, plus the opportunity to build practical capability in LLMs, SLMs, automation and agent platforms.
  • Long-standing client relationships in which MultiBase is the established, trusted partner for solving real data problems.
  • Compensation: competitive and aligned with market benchmarks, based on experience and location.

Growth path

This role starts with senior hands-on delivery. As MultiBase and its AI-driven data-product work grow, strong performance can lead to broader responsibility in solution architecture, technical leadership, delivery leadership and the development of new client offerings.

The direction depends on your strengths, the company's needs and the results you create.

What success looks like

After three months

  • You understand your client team, their processes and their data landscape.
  • You contribute billable work within the agreed delivery plan.
  • Your data products are tested, documented and ready for production use.
  • You use MultiBase delivery standards and AI-native working practices consistently.
  • You have identified at least one practical AI-driven data-product opportunity for further evaluation.

After six months

  • Client stakeholders trust you with defined technical questions and delivery topics.
  • Your work meets agreed quality standards and peer review requires only minor refinements.
  • You have contributed at least one useful SOP or knowledge-base entry.
  • You have identified at least one concrete improvement opportunity in a client data landscape and discussed it with your Tech Lead and project lead.

title: Senior Systems Engineer - Product Security (m/f/d)
description: Fernride is building the future of autonomous logistics by combining advanced automation technology with human‑guided teleoperations. We enable logistics companies to transition toward safer, more efficient, and more sustainable driverless operations. With strong expertise in robotics, AI, and automotive engineering, Fernride delivers scalable solutions that bring real‑world autonomy to industrial environments. The Quantum Systems Land Domain is developing leading-edge autonomous UGV technology for defense — a domain where no blueprint exists. The product strategy starts with a UGV that is useful on today’s battlefields and can be built with current technology, then progressively increases the authority of the autonomy system while reducing the need for human supervision — across ever more complex operating environments, up to fully autonomous operation in proximity to civilians. As a senior cybersecurity expert, you will own and shape product security from the ground up: define the threat landscape, build the security processes, and drive defense-in-depth across the platform. You will work closely with system safety engineers, design assurance, hardware/software engineering teams, and V&V to ensure cybersecurity is embedded across the full product lifecycle. As the product matures, you will grow your domain into a team. What is your Day to Day Mission: Design Assurance – Sicherstellen, dass sicherheits- und sicherheitsrelevante Funktionen korrekt in Hardware, Software und ML umgesetzt werden. Safety & Threat Analysis – Durchführung von FMEA/FMECA, Risikoanalysen und TARA zur Identifikation von Fehlermodi, Bedrohungen und Angriffspfaden. Technical Architecture – Mitgestaltung der technischen Architektur inkl. Safety‑Mechanismen, Security Controls, Trust Boundaries und Safe‑State‑Strategien. Requirements Management – Pflege der Systemanforderungen mit vollständiger Traceability für Safety, Security und Compliance. Verification & Validation – Definition von Testkriterien, Fault‑Injection‑ und Penetration‑Test‑Scopes; Review von V&V‑Nachweisen. Compliance – Unterstützung bei regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. LVD, EMC, CRA, RED‑Security, AI‑Act‑Security) und Pflege relevanter Dokumentation. Supply Chain Security – Bewertung von Drittanbieter‑Komponenten, SBOM‑Pflege und sichere Beschaffungsanforderungen. Operational Measures – Definition von Incident Response, Monitoring, Patch‑Management und Schlüsselverwaltung. Cross‑Functional Collaboration – Enge Zusammenarbeit mit System Safety, Product Security, Design Assurance und Engineering‑Teams. Implementation Guidance – Übersetzung von Safety‑ und Security‑Maßnahmen in konkrete technische Vorgaben; Review von Designs auf Fehlermodi und Angriffsflächen. AI‑Assisted Workflows – Entwicklung KI‑gestützter Prozesse für Analyse, Traceability und Compliance. What you bring to the team: Deep expertise in cybersecurity management and engineering for embedded  systems, with an engineering mindset and hands-on attitude. Understanding of IT and embedded systems technology, and state-of-the-art security controls and approaches. Experience with threat analysis and risk assessment (TARA), attacker modeling, and defense-in-depth architecture for resource-constrained platforms. Experience with supply chain security — CVE tracking, SBOM management, secure procurement requirements. Understanding of secure development lifecycle practices — code review, static analysis, dependency scanning, CI/CD security gates. Strong collaboration skills — you work closely with safety engineers, hardware/software teams, and V&V to find feasible solutions that don’t cause unacceptable cybersecurity risks.Interest in AI-assisted engineering workflows and willingness to shape how AI tools support security analysis and compliance management. Comfortable working with software development tools — GitHub, VS Code, Bazel, Markdown, CI/CD pipelines — to operate and evolve the AI-assisted methodology. Your Benefits:  Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles.  Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.  Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life.  Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget.  Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.  Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

This is your opportunity to own a real product at a company building something genuinely new. As our Senior Product Manager, you join a small, senior product team at a stage where one person's judgment visibly shapes the product.

You will own product topics end to end: understanding the customer, deciding what is worth building and why, shaping the concept, and seeing it through to a shipped result that delivers value. You do this for your own set of topics, alongside our Director Product Management and our CPO, who both work hands-on. You start by owning the flow of customer requests and insights, the fastest way to learn our product and our customers, and grow over the first 6 to 12 months into owning whole product areas with the same autonomy. You develop the product; our
engineers build it.

We are building a product in a new category, so there is no playbook to copy. The work is genuinely conceptual: understand how digital B2B products work, understand our users' problems, and invent viable solutions. Our engineering team works closely and continuously with product, no throwing specs over a wall, and most of that collaboration happens remotely.

If you want real ownership, the influence to shape a product from an early stage, and the discipline of a spec-driven, high-bar team, this is the right moment to join.


What will be your responsibility

  • Own a set of product topics end to end, from the customer problem through to a shipped result that delivers real value
  • Decide what is worth building and in what order for your topics, shape the concept, and drive it through delivery together with engineering
  • Run discovery with customers to understand what they actually need, test your assumptions rather than building on guesses, and turn what you learn into clear product decisions
  • Own the flow of customer requests and insights: make sense of what customers are asking for, decide what it means for the product, route it to the right place, and turn a stream of raw input into clear product direction
  • Translate real problems into clear, well-scoped, buildable definitions, working spec-driven (currently with OpenSpec) at a high bar
  • Invent viable product concepts in a category with no existing product to copy
  • Shape the UX and UI together with engineering, based on the existing product and the component library - we have no dedicated designer in the team
  • Work hand in hand with our remote engineering team throughout the build rather than through handover: analyse a solution for gaps and edge cases before it is built, using AI where it helps, and after shipping, check whether the outcome delivered its intended value and works for users



What you'll need

  • A track record of owning B2B SaaS products end to end, from customer problem to shipped outcome, with real accountability for whether they delivered value
  • A genuine understanding of how digital B2B products work, and the ability to invent viable concepts rather than copy existing patterns
  • Strong requirements and scoping judgment: you make vague problems complete, unambiguous and correctly scoped, and you know what to leave out
  • A structured, process-driven way of working, paired with genuine comfort in a fast, unstructured startup environment
  • Fluent, daily use of AI tools (Claude or equivalent) as a normal part of how you think, write specs and

  • Experience working in a spec-driven environment (OpenSpec or similar); turning fuzzy intent into rigorous, complete, buildable definition is second nature to you
  • Data-model fluency: you reason comfortably about entities and how they relate, enough to break problems down and hold a real bar with engineering
  • Technical fluency: not afraid of a terminal, and able to reason about data flows, system constraints, and how an agentic product behaves
  • Proven experience collaborating closely with a remote engineering team
  • Fluent in English; professional German is a strong plus given our customers



What we'll offer you

  • Remote-first setup, Europe-based so we stay reasonably timezone-aligned, with access to our Munich office and backyard workspace
  • Flexible working hours and a "take what you need" vacation policy
  • Direct collaboration with our Director Product Management and CPO, and real ownership of your own product areas
  • Competitive salary plus virtual ESOP, so you grow with us
  • A team of motivated, kind, and inspiring colleagues
  • A role in a growing SaaS company in the Data & AI space, joining at the ideal moment to make a lasting impact
  • Regular team events and some friendly Spikeball or Table Tennis matches



Extra props for

  • Experience in the Data, Analytics, or AI space
  • Experience with AI or agentic products
  • Experience building in a new or emerging product category
  • Experience working in a remote-first team
  • Curiosity for technology and innovation
  • Strong Spikeball or Table Tennis skills (our signature Mindfuel games)

title: Interim project - Senior DevOps Consultant (f/m/d)
description: Job description We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin. The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions. The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites. As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders. Your responsibilities Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work. Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code. Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation. Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure. Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation. Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity. Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance. Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure. Your profile Relevant Tech Skills Required: Python and shell scripting. Linux servers in production. Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker). Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent). Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling). Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design. A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context. Nice to have: S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph). Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools. Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM). Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information. Some experience deploying AI projects. Qualifications You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud). Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects. You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks. A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment. Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!). Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills. Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders. Good communication skills in English. Our offer Conditions Application Deadline: The position remains open until filled Expected start of assignment: As soon as possible, by mutual agreement. Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignment Terms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement. Please apply with your CV and cover letter in PDF format exclusively using the application form at the earliest opportunity. Please indicate in your cover letter your earliest possible start date and your expected daily rate. Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed. We encourage you to apply using the application form. We are a diverse and inclusive team and welcome your application regardless of your gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect that makes you unique. and help the team grow through pair programming and mentoring</li> <li>You are comfortable speaking and writing in English in your day-to-day with the team, German is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Now, governmental or regulated health systems (e.g. Telematik-Infrastruktur, eRezept, GDT)</li> <li>Are familiar with the German digital health ecosystem</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we (up to a maximum of 30 days)</li> <li>Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy</li> <li>Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz</li> <li>Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)</li> <li>Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth</li> <li>The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more</li> <li>Free mental health and coaching services through Nachweisbarer Track Record im Neukundengeschäft mit erklärungsbedürftigen Leistungen und längeren Sales-Zyklen. Verständnis für die Welt von Investor Relations, Unternehmenskommunikation und Nachhaltigkeitsberichterstattung (CSRD/ESG) – oder die klare Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit, sich diese schnell zu erschließen. Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixum plus leistungsstarke, ungedeckelte variable Komponente. Flexibilität: Mobiles Arbeiten und moderne Arbeitsbedingungen an unseren Standorten. description: <p>This role is part of our Central Finance Team at<a href="https://saas.group"> saas.group.</a></p> <h2><strong>What is saas.group?</strong></h2> <p>Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400+ colleagues spanning 45 countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow <a href="https://saas.group/family/">24 exciting brands</a> under our umbrella.<strong> </strong>Feel free to explore our <a href="https://saas.group/candidate-hub/">Candidate's Hub</a> to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.</p> <p>Also, don’t forget to follow <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/saas-group/">saas.group on LinkedIn</a> to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.</p> <h2><strong>Profile Overview</strong></h2> <p>This is a critical role in our global Finance team that manages accounting, controlling and legal functions in our growing group of currently 18 international entities. You will report to our Director of Accounting and Tax and be responsible for all aspects of operational accounting for several entities. In your daily work you will often interact with our CFO, our Group Controlling Lead and the managing directors of many of our portfolio brands.</p> <p>This position offers a unique opportunity to take your accounting career to the next level by becoming part of a fast growing software startup with opportunities to grow your profile in areas such as consolidation and group accounting, international GAAP and merger &amp; acquisitions.</p> <h2><strong>Your responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Oversee all aspects of accounting for our entities’ billing, general ledger, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, revenue recognition, tax and various special analyses.</li> <li>Maintain general ledger reconciliations with adequate documentation for all balance sheet accounts.</li> <li>Responsible for financial reporting, analysis, and commentary of your portfolio and support with consolidation and monthly group reporting&nbsp;</li> <li>Run annual financial statements and audits, preparing and filing of VAT, sales tax and GST returns</li> <li>Support our Leadership Team in tax matters and international billing, monitor and prepare intercompany transactions</li> <li>Work with external accountants, tax advisors, auditors and other service providers</li> <li>Play a vital part in the company's financial management which includes all account reconciliations and reporting to necessary parties</li> <li>Supervision and optimization of the company’s accounting principles, practices, procedures, and initiatives</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You bring to the table</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in accountancy or similar qualification and at least 5 years experience as an accountant</li> <li>Minimum 3 years hands-on experience with NetSuite</li> <li>Prior work experience at a SaaS or Software company</li> <li>Experience with Billing or Revenue Recognition tool (Stripe, Chargebee)&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with all-round accounting (AR, AP, Payroll, GL, tax, audit)&nbsp;</li> <li>Good knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS</li> <li>Experience in supporting annual audits</li> <li>Independent, structured, solution-oriented and analytical way of working&nbsp;</li> <li>Great time management skills and strong ability to stay organized and deliver closer to financial deadlines</li> <li>Professional fluency in German and English</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What's in it for You</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ultimate flexibility:</strong> We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.</li> <li><strong>Freedom and autonomy:</strong> We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.</li> <li><strong>Minimum bureaucracy:</strong> We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady &amp; sustainable.</li> <li><strong>Small &amp; friendly team:</strong> We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.</li> <li><strong>Our network:</strong> We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning&nbsp; and expertise with each other internally.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Flexible time off:</strong> We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.</li> </ul> <p>We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” <em>to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.&nbsp;</em></p> <p>Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>—</p> <p><em>saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.</em></p> <p><em>We believe in fair and transparent pay. raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Technical owner of Proxima’s AI agent platform, turning autonomous agents into reliable everyday colleagues for physicists and engineers.

  • Own the platform architecture, technical delivery, and day-to-day operation.

  • Scale the platform from an early product into reliable, governed infrastructure used across the company.

  • Enable agents to work across knowledge bases, write code, run simulations, and support engineering workflows.

  • Work within the Enterprise AI Team Lead’s overall vision while owning how that vision is technically implemented.

  • Use strong technical judgment to influence and shape the platform roadmap.

  • Identify and propose new platform features based on hands-on experience and feedback from internal users.

  • Build a platform that engineers and scientists can trust for real, production-level work.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the design, delivery, and operation of our agent platform: the runtime and its primitives: durable sessions, sandboxed execution environments, long-running task execution, memory, and tool integration

  • Turn a rapidly evolving agent ecosystem into stable platform building blocks: evaluate harnesses, models, and protocols as they emerge, and decide what becomes a supported primitive versus a passing experiment

  • Co-Design the integration layer that connects agents to internal and external systems, from enterprise tools to our scientific computing stack, and the standards for how tools, skills, and context are exposed to agents

  • Make autonomy safe and governable: permission and approval flows with human-in-the-loop escalation, capability boundaries, audit logging, cost and token controls, and hardening against prompt injection and tool abuse

  • Build the evaluation and observability layer for non-deterministic systems: session tracing, quality evals, and cost/latency visibility, so we know agents work before our users have to find out

  • Operate what you build on Google Cloud with production discipline: reliability, failure handling, and observability

  • Work directly with demanding technical users and feed their feedback and your technical judgment into the platform roadmap you shape together with the team lead

WHO YOU ARE

Must have

  • You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with real depth in Python and distributed backend systems

  • You have architected, built, and operated production-grade agentic or LLM systems well beyond the prototype phase

  • You know the current agent ecosystem hands-on: MCP, agent SDKs and CLIs, multi-agent orchestration patterns, sandboxed code execution and have formed opinions on where the abstractions should sit

  • You have run production workloads on Kubernetes and a major cloud (ideally GCP), and know what it takes to keep stateful, long-running services alive

  • You treat evaluation and observability as platform features, not afterthoughts

  • You take security seriously as a design constraint

  • You think in platforms and internal products

  • You are a low-ego, high-clarity communicator who can work directly with expert users and build consensus across teams

  • You have experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD

Nice to have

  • Experience with model gateways and routing

  • Exposure to scientific or high-performance computing: batch schedulers, HPC clusters, or simulation-heavy environments

  • Open-source contributions to AI/agent tooling

  • A track record of technical mentorship

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30min)


*This role sits at "L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

About the Role:

At Camunda, we are evolving how software gets built. We are looking for a Product Builder to help shape the enterprise and governance experience of Camunda Hub by combining product thinking, user empathy, UX judgment, and hands-on execution. This is a high-ownership role inside our Products organization for someone who wants to move quickly, work directly with customers and forward deployed engineers, and build in an AI-first environment.

Camunda Hub is the unified management platform through which teams govern their processes, manage access, and administer the platform at enterprise scale. You will join the Enterprise & Governance pod, which owns the surfaces enterprise Centres of Excellence and platform administrators rely on: access control and permissions, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance features, and the administration and configuration UI for clusters and platform settings.

The role will contribute across the full stack, enabling faster end-to-end product delivery.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Discover and clarify meaningful user problems for administrators, CoE teams, and enterprise architects by working closely with customers, forward deployed engineers, and internal stakeholders

  • Shape product direction through practical judgment, fast iteration, and a strong focus on solving the underlying problem rather than only implementing requests

  • Prototype, build, harden, ship, and iterate on product improvements across the enterprise and governance surfaces of Hub - access control, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance, and platform administration

  • Use AI tools effectively to accelerate first drafts, implementation steps, iteration, and learning while maintaining a strong quality bar

  • Work closely with other builders and product strategy counterparts to turn ideas into shipped outcomes, including across boundaries with Core / Identity where governance surfaces build on platform contracts

  • Improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of how the pod delivers product end-to-end

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Experience shipping product directly in a software environment

  • Ability to work fluidly across product thinking, user experience, and hands-on delivery

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and turning open-ended problems into practical next steps

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote-first, pod-based environment

  • Curiosity about users, fast learning loops, and a bias toward improving the product through iteration

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping product in a software context, not only coordinating roadmap or requirements

  • Strong AI-native delivery habits: able to use AI tools effectively for first drafts, implementation steps, and iteration, while reviewing and improving weak output rather than accepting it

  • Ability to describe and shape intended user experience clearly, including flow, hierarchy, states, copy, and accessibility expectations

  • Strong product and customer judgment: able to understand the user problem behind a request, use lightweight evidence and customer feedback, and make pragmatic decisions that create broader product value

  • Sound technical judgment within an established architecture, including the ability to test what was built, trace issues, understand frontend/backend boundaries, and contribute beyond a pure frontend scope over time

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with workflow software, orchestration, admin/platform tooling, or similarly technical product surfaces

  • Experience working in small, high-autonomy pods with broad ownership across discovery, design, and delivery

  • Familiarity with enterprise governance concerns: identity and access management, RBAC and permission models, multi-tenancy, audit logging, or compliance-driven requirements

  • Experience designing for administrator and platform-operator personas

  • Ability to capture validation learnings clearly, distinguish signal from noise, and help improve lightweight product validation practices

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

raw.title: VP, Growth
raw.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing?

  • Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

  • Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand

  • Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts

  • Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does

  • Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment

  • Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows

  • Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts

  • Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned

  • Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it

What do we need from you?

  • Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport

  • A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for

  • Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative

  • Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel

  • Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months

  • Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board

  • The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model

  • Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step

  • Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture

  • Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue

  • International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages

  • Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup

Our culture and what we offer 🌍

We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way.

Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🏥 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and continuous learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 📈 The chance to join a company in its exponential expansion phase

Benefits vary by country of employment - your recruiter will walk you through the specifics for your location.

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the global industry we serve. We welcome applications regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let it stop you - if you think you'd thrive here, we'd rather hear from you than not.

title: Associate Partner - AI & Data - Life Sciences
description: Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale. We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain. We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core. Role At Visium, you'll have the opportunity to take on an entrepreneurial role, contributing to the organization’s growth and finding innovative ways to create meaningful impact for clients. Your mission will involve advising C-Level executives on their AI & Data strategies and guiding large-scale digital transformations. You’ll act as a trusted advisor and a key source of strategic insight, overseeing and nurturing long-term client relationships while ensuring the highest quality of delivery. As an Associate Partner you will be responsible for:  Creating new business opportunities and expanding existing ones. Rely on your extensive network and collaborate with our business development team to create new business opportunities in LifeScience. Engage with our client’s C-level stakeholders to understand their Data and AI related challenges, developing solutions and support them in implementing and scaling them in a sustainable way. Lead and collaborate effectively within large cross-functional teams to review and analyze client requirements or challenges and provide leadership and direction  to elevate our delivery capabilities.  Lead engagement teams in developing logical and insightful analyses; innovative & effective recommendations and high-quality deliverables. Depending on your previous experiences and appetite to grow, you will play an active role in practice development. Requirements What we are looking for Director, Associate Partner/Partner level (or equivalent title) experience at a consulting firm. Data Science background and specialization across LifeScience & Healthcare are required.  Proven track record of developing new client relationships and generating business development opportunities that leads to successful client engagements. Demonstrated ability with the management of a portfolio of healthcare clients generating 7 figures in revenues in a consulting-like industry. Experience leading cross-functional teams and in-depth knowledge/defined involvement in helping frame, design and implement and scale solutions for challenging business situations. Exceptional intellectual and analytical curiosity, a creative visionary who can drive innovation. Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English. French and/or German are considered a plus.  Benefits Benefits What we offer A competitive compensation package A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us A position that enables you to have an impact on 1’000s of people, and the whole company's growth. An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset Check our LinkedIn and website to learn more about us & don’t hesitate to contact us if you have any questions. title: Senior IT Operations & Service Manager (m/w/d)
description: Dein täglicher Verantwortungsbereich: Der operative Betrieb unseres internen IT-Bereichs liegt in deinen Händen: Du packst selbst mit an, strukturierst Themen und sorgst dafür, dass technische Aufgaben pragmatisch umgesetzt werden. Gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team stellst du den zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Office IT -Infrastruktur und unserer Microsoft-basierten Arbeitsumgebung sicher. Bei technischen Fragestellungen gehst du lösungsorientiert vor, analysierst Ursachen und unterstützt aktiv bei der Umsetzung. IT-Projekte planst du strukturiert, priorisierst Aufgaben sinnvoll und bringst Themen gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Dienstleistern voran. Externe Dienstleister steuerst du verbindlich und stellst sicher, dass Leistungen, Verantwortlichkeiten und technische Entscheidungen zu unseren Anforderungen passen. Unseren IT-Support entwickelst du schrittweise zu einem strukturierteren Service-Modell weiter und übersetzt wiederkehrende Themen in klare Prozesse. Jira Service Management gestaltest du gemeinsam mit dem Team als zentrale Plattform für Anfragen und Support weiter. In IT- und Informationssicherheits-Audits sowie regelmäßigen Zertifizierungen sorgst du dafür, dass Prozesse, Verantwortlichkeiten und Nachweise sauber aufgebaut und gepflegt werden. Deine Kompetenzen: Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Weiterentwicklung moderner IT-Umgebungen mit. Microsoft-basierte Unternehmensumgebungen sind dir vertraut und du verstehst, wie eine sichere und skalierbare IT für ein wachsendes Unternehmen aufgebaut wird. IT-Projekte kannst du strukturieren, Prioritäten setzen und unterschiedliche Aufgaben, Beteiligte und Abhängigkeiten zuverlässig zusammenführen. Technische Lösungsansätze beurteilst du sicher und gehst bei Störungen pragmatisch, analytisch und umsetzungsorientiert vor. Mit Microsoft 365, Entra ID und Intune hast du bereits gearbeitet. Die Zusammenarbeit mit externen IT-Dienstleistern ist dir vertraut und du kannst technische Empfehlungen kritisch einordnen. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung von Kolleg:innen ist hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung; wichtiger ist, dass du Verantwortung übernehmen und dich in eine Führungsrolle weiterentwickeln möchtest. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschst du sicher und kommunizierst mit technischen Teams ebenso souverän wie mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern. Unsere Werte, dein Mindset: Team First: Ein Team, ein Ziel - Gemeinsam sind wir stark. Wir wachsen durch gegenseitige Unterstützung. Customer Success Is Our DNA: Identifiziere, hinterfrage und verfolge die Ziele Deines Kunden. Feiert gemeinsam den Erfolg. Never Stop Reinventing: Sei offen für Neues und gehe Veränderungen mutig an. Hinterfrage Prozesse, liefere Lösungsvorschläge und neue Ideen. Be Yourself And Make Goals Work: Sei Du selbst. Erreiche Großes! Deine Benefits bei uns: Remote Wor k: Flexibles Arbeitsmodell - arbeite bis zu 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder nutze unser modernes Office in Hamburg. Urlau b : Mehr Zeit für das, was dir wichtig ist - zusätzlich zu 30 Urlaubstagen kannst du deinen Jahresurlaub durch Gehaltsumwandlung auf bis zu 40 Tage erhöhen. Workati on : Arbeiten, wo du dich inspirieren lässt - arbeite einmal pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland. Nach zwei Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit sind sogar weitere internationale Workation -Möglichkeiten möglich. Gesundh eit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen - mit unserer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung erhältst du ein jährliches Gesundheitsbudget für zahlreiche Gesundheitsleistungen. Dein Wahlben efit : Du entscheidest, was am besten zu d einem Alltag passt - wähle zwischen einem Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club, einem bezuschussten JobTicket oder einer Edenred -Sachbezugskarte für d eine Einkäufe. JobRa d : Ob für den Arbeitsweg oder deine Freizeit - lease dein JobRad über uns und profitiere von attraktiven steuerlichen Vorteilen. Altersvorso rge: Wir denken heute schon an morgen - sichere deine Zukunft mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge inklusive 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss. Verantwortung & Entw icklung: Raum für Eigeninitiative statt starrer Hierarchien - übernimm Verantwortung, bringe deine Ideen ein und gestalte die Zukunft der Reos Gruppe aktiv mit. Netw orking: Zweimal im Jahr kommt die gesamte Reos Gruppe in Hamburg zusammen - freue dich auf unvergessliche Firmenevents, persönlichen Austausch und echte gemeinsame Erlebnisse. Marketing bei uns bedeutet: aus guten Ideen sichtbare Ergebnisse machen

Du möchtest Marketingprojekte nicht nur begleiten, sondern eigenständig planen, umsetzen und weiterentwickeln? Dann werde Teil von uns.

Wir sind ein 2023 von Oscar Schwarz und Ludwig Sickert gegründetes Berliner KI-Startup. Wir entwickeln AI Agents, Voicebots und Automatisierungslösungen für den Kundenservice – insbesondere für Unternehmen im deutschen Mittelstand. Mit AIdapt entwickeln wir außerdem ein eigenes SaaS-Produkt zur Analyse und messbaren Verbesserung von AI Agents.

Als B2B Marketing Spezialist:in arbeitest du eng mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Gründerteam zusammen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für verschiedene Marketingkanäle und Projekte – von Social Media und Content über Website und Kampagnen bis hin zu Messen und Events. Aufgaben

  • Du koordinierst Marketingkampagnen, insbesondere über LinkedIn und Google Ads, und arbeitest bei Bedarf mit externen Spezialist:innen zusammen.
  • Du planst und organisierst Messe- und Eventauftritte – von der Recherche und Bewerbung über Checklisten und Materialien bis zur Nachbereitung.
  • Du bist bei ausgewählten Messen und Veranstaltungen vor Ort dabei und gestaltest unseren Auftritt aktiv mit.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Marketingposition.

raw.description:
A little about us

  • AI-native design: Kittl is becoming the AI-native, operating system for creative businesses. We give small brands the creative firepower to look credible and get from idea to launch-ready, with no agency and no design team

  • Rapid growth: 11 million users since 2022

  • Diverse team: 120+ people from 30+ countries, with offices in Berlin and Düsseldorf and teammates working remotely

  • Truly product-led company: Engineers, Product Managers and Designers sit at the core of what we build

  • Strong backing: Raised over $50M, led by IVP with Left Lane Capital and Speedinvest. IVP has also backed Figma, Slack, and Dropbox

Learn more: www.kittl.com/career

Your role at Kittl

Kittl's marketing is conversion-led - great at driving performance, but no one owns what Kittl is like, how it makes people feel, or whether our target audience has even heard of us. We need someone who can write the line that makes a founder feel seen, and who's restless about getting Kittl in front of that founder in the first place - through ideas bold enough to actually cut through. This works alongside our design lead, who owns visual identity. This role owns voice, story, and standing out.

This role is for you if

  • You have a gift for language - you notice when a sentence is doing real work versus just filling space

  • You get restless with "safe" - you'd rather pitch the slightly-crazy activation that gets talked about than the tenth version of a banner ad

  • You think about audience obsessively - not just what to say, but where our founders actually are, and how to show up there in a way that sticks

  • You notice the thing everyone else scrolled past - the landing page headline that's almost right, the caption that undersells the idea, the touchpoint nobody double-checked

  • You can't walk past something that's almost good enough - you stop, look again, and fix it before it ships

  • You've spent time at an agency or in a fast-moving creative environment - you know how to move from a wild idea to something that actually ships

  • You are both creative and strategic - you can go bananas with ideas ,and just as readily hold the line on what keeps them on-brand

What you'll do

  • Define and codify Kittl's voice and tone - then write the work yourself (manifesto, campaign copy, landing pages, launch narratives) at a level others can point to as the standard

  • Dream up and lead brand activations, stunts, and campaigns designed to get Kittl in front of small business founders and make them actually care - concept through delivery

  • Represent brand thinking in leadership and strategy conversations, pushing back where decisions threaten brand consistency/integrity

  • Find and pitch unconventional ways to build awareness - partnerships, community moments, founder-facing events, anything that gets us known beyond our existing paid and influencer channels

  • Bring bold, sometimes "crazy" ad concepts to growth/performance marketing - and know how to make them convert, not just turn heads

  • Guide teams early - in briefs and reviews - so tone and ambition are right from the start, not fixed after

  • Audit our messaging and presence across our touch-points (website, landing pages, ad/video scripts, campaign concepts, brand activations), ensuring excellence and consistency in all

Who you are

  • 5+ years (into your career - sharp instincts, real experience, not yet coasting on a title)

  • Agency background, ideally 2–3 years at a creative/brand agency followed by in-house brand experience at a startup or fast-growing company

  • Background in FMCG, DTC, or consumer goods brands is a strong plus

  • Comfortable being the lone brand voice in a growth-led org - you can push for ambition without being precious

  • Used to operating with real autonomy - comfortable figuring things out without a big team or a heavy approval chain

  • Social media or community-building experience is a plus

Show us, don't tell us

Portfolio: Send 3–5 pieces of writing, campaigns, or activation concepts you're genuinely proud of

Interview process

  • Recruiter interview (30 min)

  • Hiring Manager interview (45 min)

  • Case Study interview (60 min)

  • Bar Raiser interview (45 min)

You'll do well here if

  • You pick up problems nobody assigned you. If something's broken and no one has stepped up, you're the person who does

  • You'd rather make the call and adjust than wait until you're certain. Velocity is the only advantage that can't be copied

  • You want to own a domain deeply enough that people rely on your judgement in it, whether or not you manage anyone

  • You'll argue for your position and commit fully when the call goes the other way

  • You care about details other people would call excessive. Our standards are higher than most people think is reasonable, on purpose

  • You use AI constantly and still own every word you ship

It's probably not the right fit if

  • You need consensus before you move

  • You'd rather specialise narrowly than own a whole problem end to end

  • You find it draining to have your thinking challenged in the open. We do that a lot, and it's sometimes uncomfortable

Every new hire should raise the bar in some meaningful way, not just fill a seat. We hold to that, and it's why you'll be working with the most talented people from all over the world.

Benefits

  • Maximise your impact: Real ownership of what you ship. Whether you lead a team or lead through craft, we back you to do the work that matters most

  • Shape AI-native creative work: Kittl sits where AI, design, and commerce meet. You'll build the tools that decide what professional looks like for our next million users

  • AI enablement: We use AI across the company, not just in the product

  • Passionate team: Quarterly hackathons for experimenting with new concepts, pushing boundaries, and delivering the next big thing

  • Kittl Week: Each year, our global team gathers for a whole week, to work, celebrate, get inspired, and have fun

  • Work-life balance: 30 vacation days a year, plus public holidays

  • Flexible hours: Core hours are 11am to 5pm CET. How you build the rest of your day is up to you

  • Hybrid working style: 3 days a week in our office in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, the rest of the week from home

  • Remote work: On top of that, work from anywhere in the world for up to 50 days (10 weeks) a year, as long as you're reachable during core hours

  • VESOP: Enrollment in our Virtual Employee Stock Option Plan. When Kittl grows in value, you share in it

  • Lunch: Daily chef-prepared meals in the office.

  • Mobility: Your monthly BVG ticket, fully covered

  • Health & fitness: Urban Sports Club M membership

  • Learning & development: Annual L&D budget for your professional growth

  • German classes: Online group courses at every level

🌈 At Kittl, we embrace diversity and value every team member's unique background, identity, and experience. We're all about respect, honesty, and inclusivity. Together, we create a safe and supportive work environment where everyone thrives. Join us on this exciting journey of making our company and product even better!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code. This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it. What You'll Own Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself. Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools. Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data. Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system. Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize. Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable. First 90 Days One way the first 90 could unfold. Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Embed with a first customer, learn their workflow, and define the real problem. Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Build and deploy a production system they actually use. Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Spot the pattern worth productizing and work with R&D to turn it into platform. What You Bring 2+ years of professional software engineering, with software shipped end to end. Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar). Ability to work across the stack and learn unfamiliar systems quickly. Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. Willingness to travel to client sites as needed. Nice to Have A track record of shipping real systems with real users, not just assigned tasks. High agency and strong prioritization: you find the core problem and move. Comfort defining your own path when there isn't one. Evidence of working directly with customers and translating what you heard into what you built. Clear communication, including explaining a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder. Luma's mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world. title: Operations Lead (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Steuerberatung ist ein operatives Geschäft. Jede Buchung, jede Lohnabrechnung, jeder Abschluss folgt einem Ablauf – und die meisten dieser Abläufe wurden nie systematisch hinterfragt. Sie funktionieren, weil erfahrene Menschen ihre Workarounds kennen, nicht weil sie durchdacht sind. Genau das ist der Hebel, der in dieser Branche noch niemandem gehört. Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und entwickelt sie weiter, statt sie einzuschmelzen. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Das funktioniert nur, wenn darunter etwas steht, das trägt: Prozesse, die an jedem Standort gleich laufen, Technologie, die im Alltag tatsächlich genutzt wird, und eine Integration, die bei der fünften Übernahme schneller geht als bei der ersten. Diese Schicht baust du. Sie existiert heute nicht. Du bringst Erfahrung aus dem Aufbau operativer Systeme mit – aus einem B2B-Scaleup, einem Company Builder, einer Beratung mit eigener Umsetzungsverantwortung oder aus deiner eigenen Gründung. Du wechselst, weil dein Mandat kleiner geworden ist als deine Verarbeitungskraft: zu viel Abstimmung, zu wenig Hebel, zu viele Konzepte, die andere umsetzen. Bei Vogel findest du das Gegenteil von beidem – Strukturen, die tragen, mit etablierten Mandanten und einer starken Wachstumsbasis, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht. Du verantwortest Operations bei Vogel in ganzer Breite: die Automatisierung der Abläufe im Kerngeschäft, die internen Werkzeuge und die Datenarchitektur, die IT- und Identitäts-Infrastruktur samt Endgeräten und Sicherheit, die technische Integration jeder übernommenen Einheit und die Abläufe rund um Eintritt, Vertrag, Systeme und Austritt unserer eigenen Leute. Du baust das Team, das diese Themen trägt, und verteilst die Schwerpunkte darin. Weil der Bereich am Standort München neu entsteht und über dir keine weitere Ebene sitzt, berichtest du direkt an die Geschäftsführung und arbeitest unmittelbar mit Moritz Vogel – das ist der Aufbau-Charakter dieser ersten Rolle, kein Dauerzustand. Mit der Größe des Bereichs wächst dein Mandat in die Gesamtverantwortung für den Betrieb. Deine Verantwortung Automatisierung des Kerngeschäfts Analysiere die Abläufe in Finanzbuchführung, Lohn, Abschluss und Beratung an den Standorten – vor Ort, am realen Prozess, mit den Menschen, die ihn täglich ausführen – und automatisiere die Teile, die sich automatisieren lassen. Verantworte den Werkzeug-Stack für das operative Kerngeschäft und die unternehmensweiten Standards darauf: Was wir kaufen, was wir selbst bauen, was wir abschalten. Du entscheidest das, nicht ein Gremium. Hol das Maximum aus dem, was schon da ist. Ein erheblicher Teil der Funktionalität, für die wir bezahlen, wird heute nicht genutzt. Dein Maßstab: Jeder Prozess muss bei doppeltem Mandatsvolumen funktionieren, ohne doppelt so viele Menschen zu erfordern. Integration übernommener Einheiten Verantworte die technische Übernahme jedes neuen Standorts – Systemanbindung, Datenmigration, Zugriffe, Sicherheit, Arbeitsfähigkeit ab Tag eins. Mach aus der Integration einen wiederholbaren Ablauf statt eines Projekts: Was beim ersten Standort drei Monate dauert, muss beim vierten in Wochen laufen. Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen — Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent — und nach Profil gestaffelt. Für Einstiegsrollen (Praktikum, Werkstudium, Berufseinstieg) genügen in der Regel zwei Gespräche und eine kurze Arbeitsprobe; erfahrene Rollen laufen etwas ausführlicher. Bei ausgewählten Senior-Rollen prüfen wir, künftig einen gemeinsamen Arbeitstag einzubauen, damit beide Seiten sich besser kennenlernen. Immer gilt: getaktete Termine, zügige Entscheidung, substanzielles Feedback — unabhängig vom Ausgang.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung — du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test — liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft: Ownership, Qualität, Lernkurve, Zusammenarbeit, Impact.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich — welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: Mastery (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) und Pioneer (Führung, Management). Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke — vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Ein gemeinsames Mittagessen ist ein offenes tägliches Angebot — keine Pflicht; wer mag, kommt dazu, essen kann jeder jederzeit. Dazu Abendessen, Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus — nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits: durchdacht und substanziell, nicht symbolisch. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

8. Ich kenne jemanden — gibt es einen Empfehlungsbonus?

Ja — 2.500 EUR für jede erfolgreich besetzte Stelle (keine Praktika). Kurzer Kontext reicht: an wen du denkst, für welche Rolle, warum. Muss nicht perfekt sitzen, aber substanziell sein.

Wir suchen

… als Senior Product Manager:in Service Cockpit entwickelst du einen intern getesteten Prototypen zu einer produktiven Anwendung weiter. Damit können unsere Servicetechniker:innen Wärmepumpen aus der Ferne prüfen, Fehler schneller eingrenzen und sichere Einstellungen vornehmen.
Dein Ziel: weniger Vor-Ort-Einsätze und ein Werkzeug, das im Servicealltag wirklich hilft.

Du verbindest Daten aus verschiedenen Herstellerwelten und baust das Produkt selbst, mit AI als deinem Entwicklungsteam. Du spezifizierst, gestaltest, baust, bringst es live und betreibst es. Ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam gibt es für diese Rolle nicht, und es wird keines geben. Wer Tickets schreiben und übergeben will, ist hier falsch.


Wenn Du daran Spaß hast

  • das Service Cockpit gemeinsam mit unseren Techniker:innen von der Discovery bis zum Betrieb aufzubauen, den intern getesteten Read-only-Prototypen in kurzen Zyklen zu einer stabilen Produktivanwendung weiterzuentwickeln und die technische Basis selbst festzulegen
  • ein kanonisches Datenmodell für unsere eigene Wärmepumpenplattform sowie die Systeme von Buderus und LG zu definieren und mit unserem Datenteam umzusetzen
  • fehlende Messwerte, unklare Fehlercodes, technische Datenlücken und fehlende Zugänge mit Analytics, HEMS, Platform, IT, Security und den Herstellern zu klären
  • sichere Schreibzugriffe für ausgewählte Einstellungen zu bauen, Rollen und Berechtigungen abzustimmen und wiederkehrende Wartungsaufgaben aus der Ferne zu automatisieren
  • am echten Fall mit unseren Techniker:innen zu arbeiten, vermiedene Anfahrten und die First-Time-Fix-Rate zu messen und die Plattform danach auszubauen: mit Kundenreporting, Predictive Maintenance gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Science-Team, weiteren Assetklassen, einer nativen App und der Anbindung an unsere Serviceprozesse


Und Dich hier wiedererkennst

  • Erfahrung & Ownership: Du bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Produktmanagement, in Product Engineering oder mit Datenprodukten mit. Du hast Produkte selbst bis in den produktiven Einsatz gebracht, Verantwortung für ein unfertiges Produkt übernommen, eigene Prioritäten gesetzt und gemessen, ob deine Lösung im Alltag tatsächlich etwas verbessert.
  • Build-Erfahrung: Du hast eigenständig funktionierende Anwendungen mit AI-Coding-Tools gebaut. Im Gespräch zeigst du uns, was du entwickelt hast, und erklärst deine technischen Entscheidungen.
  • Datenverständnis: Du kannst dich in unbekannte Sensor-, Zeitreihen- und API-Daten einarbeiten, Zusammenhänge erkennen und benennen, welche Werte oder Zugänge fehlen. SQL und BI-Tools gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du musst nicht jedes Datenproblem allein lösen. Du löst es mit AI, unserem Datenteam und Tech und weißt, was du dort anfordern musst.
  • Produkturteil: Du entwickelst professionelle Oberflächen für Menschen, die unter Zeitdruck arbeiten. Deine Entscheidungen leitest du aus den Aufgaben der Techniker:innen ab, nicht aus den Feldern, die ein System zufällig liefert.
  • Schnittstellenarbeit: Du hast Daten oder Zugänge von Herstellern, Dienstleistern oder internen Plattformteams beschafft und dabei auch bei Widerständen den Überblick behalten.
  • Wärmepumpen:Wärmepumpen-Expertise ist keine Voraussetzung. Niemand wird gleichzeitig Experte für drei Herstellerwelten. Wir brauchen jemanden, der in Daten erkennt, was passiert, und die richtigen Fragen stellt. Die fachliche Tiefe baust du in den ersten Monaten auf. Dafür ist Zeit vorgesehen.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst sehr gut Englisch und mindestens Deutsch auf B2-Niveau.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Das Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Position startet ab 80.000€ bis 92.000€*
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Menschen quer durch die Gesellschaft zusammenbringt – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Hintergrund.

  • Die Möglichkeit, dein persönliches Wunsch-Elektroauto bequem mıt FINN JobAuto Leasing.
  • Corporate Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 100 Partner:innen.

Über uns

Jede Bewerbung ist willkommen bei uns - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität. Wir sind überzeugt, jeder Mensch ist wertvoll und verdient eine faire Chance.
